name: Pool_Create
proto: Pool * Pool_Create(int itemSize, int initialCount, int growBy)
comment: Temp/Memory.c: fixed-size item pool. Items are 8-byte-headed (next, pool) blocks carved from grown chunks; pools are kept in the g_poolList singly linked list.

name: Pool_Alloc
comment: Pops an item off the free list, growing the pool by growBy when empty. Returns the payload (item header + 8).

name: Pool_Free
comment: Pushes the item back onto its pool's free list (pool pointer lives at item-4).

name: Pool_Grow
comment: Allocates one chunk of `count` items and threads them onto the free list.
Head of the linked list of all live Pool objects (Memory.c)

name: Plat_Alloc
comment: Win95/grimplat.cpp: allocation through the module service table (file/line = grimplat.cpp:1182)

name: Spew_Startup
comment: Loads spew.dll on first use and calls its Spew_Startup export (debug output DLL)
spew.dll module handle (0 when not loaded)
spew.dll!Spew_Startup
spew.dll!Spew_Shutdown

name: SaveFile_CheckFUTBHeader
comment: Reads three dwords through readFn and expects 'FUTB', 1, 0. Returns 0 when the header matches, 1 otherwise.

name: DirScan_Create
proto: DirScan * DirScan_Create(char * dir, int mode, char * ext)
comment: Temp/Fileutil.c: allocates a 0x20c-byte directory scanner. mode 0-2: pattern dir\*.*, mode 3: dir\*.ext (leading '.' stripped).

name: DirScan_Reset
comment: Closes the find handle so the next DirScan_Next restarts with _findfirst

name: DirScan_Next
comment: _findfirst/_findnext wrapper. Copies the entry name into out, out+0x104 = is-directory flag (attrib & 0x10), out+0x108 = file size.

name: Grim_FindDataOnDrives
comment: grimdemo.c: scans CD-ROM drives (and network drives when g_devMode) for <drive>\<subdir>; shows the _engn006/_engn007 'could not find data' message and returns 0 if none has it.

name: Grim_Init
comment: grimdemo.c: whole-engine startup: service tables, registry/config, window + 256-colour check, display enumeration, resource system, Lua engine lib registration, iMUSE.

name: Grim_DecodeRegKeyName
comment: De-obfuscates the 10-character registry key name in place by adding per-character offsets

name: Grim_FatalMessageBox
proto: int Grim_FatalMessageBox(HWND hwnd, char * text, char * caption, uint flags)
comment: MessageBoxA wrapper that first tears down the display so the box is visible

name: Grim_Shutdown
comment: grimdemo.c: frees the display-mode tables, closes resources, Lua, window, iMUSE, memory services

name: Grim_EnumDisplayModes
comment: Builds g_displayModes: per display device, copies the 0x54-byte mode records and (when the device has 3D hardware) the 0x22c-byte 3D driver records

name: DebugLog_Load
comment: Loads DebugLog.dll (_logPrintf/_ShowDebugLog) when running in developer mode

name: ChoreFace_Toggle
comment: Loads/unloads choreface.dll (the chore editor UI) and shows/hides it

name: DebugLog_Init
comment: Opens debug.log / resource.log and installs the debug-print callbacks into the service table
Set when the registry/config says the game runs from a developer install (allows network drives, extra logging)
One-shot fixed frame time passed to Engine_UpdateFrame, zeroed every frame
Array of 16-byte {modeCount, modes*, driverCount, drivers*} records, one per display device
